extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern DIRECT – GREAT Term is a Direct Purchase Insurance term life plan providing protection for Death, Terminal Illness, and Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) for a fixed coverage period. You can choose either (1) DIRECT – GREAT Term: a 20-year term plan or coverage until age 65, or (2) DIRECT – GREAT 5yr Term: a five-year term that is renewable for the same sum assured up to age 80, with each renewal period lasting five years. Premiums are guaranteed and the premium payment term follows the chosen policy term. The plan itself has no savings/investment features. The brochure also allows attaching a DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care rider (or 5yr Critical Care rider), which accelerates the rider’s basic sum assured upon diagnosis of specified critical illnesses, with a separate maximum CI benefit cap of S$3,000,000 across all policies/riders. TPD is capped at S$5,000,000 across all policies/riders issued by the Company on the same life assured.
quality_notes: The document is mostly feature-level text; payout amounts for base Death/Terminal Illness/TPD are not explicitly stated (except for TPD cap and CI rider mechanics).
No underwriting, medical exam, free-look, grace period, or exact definition of benefit payment for Death/Terminal Illness is provided beyond definitions.
Some structured formatting is missing (e.g., no clear tables of plan benefits/premiums), limiting extraction to what is explicitly described.

policies.quick_summary: Direct Purchase Insurance term plan (20-year term or until age 65) / renewable 5-year term up to age 80, covering Death, Terminal Illness, and Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) with guaranteed premiums. Can be enhanced with a Critical Care rider (Accelerated lump sum for specified critical illnesses; rider then terminates). No cash value if the policy ends/terminates early, per brochure statement; key caps apply to TPD and Critical Illness benefits across policies/riders on the same life assured, and sum assured is capped for all direct purchase insurance plans under the brochure’s terms statement.

Terminal illness and TPD definitions reference evidence/medical examiner and require diagnosis criteria as stated; full exclusions are referenced as being in the policy contract.
Subject to maximum TPD benefit of S$5,000,000 on all policies and riders issued by the Company on the same Life Assured.
Sum assured is capped at S$400,000 for all direct purchase insurance plans.

riders.name: DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care rider
riders.description: On diagnosis of one of the 30 critical illnesses (except for Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery), the basic sum assured will be accelerated and paid in one lump sum; the rider then terminates. For Angioplasty, 10% of the rider sum assured (up to S$25,000 per Life Assured) is payable for the treatment, and after a claim is paid, the balance continues with reduced premiums. No benefit for Angioplasty for subsequent treatments under this and any other policies and riders covering Angioplasty.
riders.eligibility: You can attach DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care to DIRECT – GREAT Term.
riders.notes: No benefit under this rider for certain specified conditions if diagnosis is made within 90 days from the date of commencement of this rider, or from the date of any reinstatement.

evidence.quote: You can attach DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care to DIRECT – GREAT Term.

On diagnosis of one of the 30 critical illnesses (except for Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery), the basic sum assured will be accelerated and paid in one lump sum. This rider will then be terminated.

For Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery (“Angioplasty”), the basic sum assured equal to 10% of the rider sum assured (up to a maximum of S$25,000 per Life Assured) will be payable if the Life Assured undergoes a treatment.
No benefit for Angioplasty will be payable for subsequent treatments under this and any other policies and riders covering Angioplasty.

No beneﬁt under this rider will be payable for Heart Attack of Speciﬁed Severity, Major Cancer, Coronary Artery By-pass Surgery or Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery if the diagnosis is made within 90 days from the date of commencement of this rider, or from the date of any reinstatement.
